decisions.why: examples are all named advanced wound dressings (Aquacel Ag Foam, Aquacel Ag Plus Dressings, Aquacel Extra Dressing, Aquacel Foam Dressing) - hydrofiber/foam dressings that are the definition of the Advanced dressings type
examples (Gentlecath Air Catheter Men, Gentlecath Glide Self Catheters, Gentlecath Air Catheter Women) are self-catheterisation products - intermittent catheters
examples (Cure Dextra Closed System Catheter, Cure Ultra, Cure Twist) are Cure Medical's closed-system intermittent self-catheters
named products (clip, gelling/odour-control sachets, hydrocolloid adhesive strips, one-piece stoma cap) are accessories, seals and skin-care items, not bags themselves

Lou's rule 25/08/2026: the division's own evidence names products from more than one category, so it goes in all of them rather than picking one — the Activelife Urostomy Pouch (urostomy bags), the Activelife Drainable Pouch (ileostomy and drainable bags) and the division's own 'Accessories' category are three distinct ostomy types
